reviews.author: Arlene McCoy
reviews.title: Good Tour, Really Well Organised
reviews.text: The tour was very well organised. One minus is that you get completely bombarded with information. You also have to stand up for too long at the private entrance to the Tower of London, which leads to a lack of time later. Lunch was the same, too stress, the quality was great but you couldn't enjoy it. I'd like to ask the organisers: please

reviews.author: Kathryn Murphy
reviews.title: Perfect Day Out With The Kids
reviews.text: Our guide was friendly and funny, and the kids loved the open-top bus. The river cruise was the highlight of the day. Everything ran on time and we never felt rushed. Highly recommended for families visiting London for the first time.

reviews.author: Marvin McKinney
reviews.title: Good Route, Crowded Bus
reviews.text: The route covers all the main sights and the guide knew a lot. However the bus was quite crowded and it was hard to hear the commentary from the back seats. Would try an earlier departure next time.

reviews.author: Savannah Nguyen
reviews.title: Romantic And Relaxing
reviews.text: We booked this for our anniversary and it was wonderful. The Thames cruise at golden hour gave us the best photos of the trip. The staff were kind and the price was fair for everything included.

reviews.author: Cody Fisher
reviews.title: Great Value For Money
reviews.text: A well planned tour that lets you see a lot in a short time. The guide gave us great tips for the rest of our stay. Only wish there was more time at the Tower of London.

reviews.author: Jerome Bell
reviews.title: Late Start And Little Information
reviews.text: The tour started 30 minutes late and the commentary was hard to follow because of the traffic noise. The sights were nice but I expected a more organised experience for this price.

reviews.author: Esther Howard
reviews.title: Best Way To See London
reviews.text: I travelled alone and this was the perfect way to meet people and see the main landmarks. The guide was passionate and shared stories I never knew. I would book again in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Wade Warren
reviews.title: Fun, But Bring A Jacket
reviews.text: We had a great time and the kids enjoyed every minute. It does get windy on the upper deck, so bring a jacket. The Changing of the Guard was amazing, and the guide picked the perfect spot to watch it.
